component.name: ELI Creation Station
component.summary: A local studio for platform content, images, video, games and code

description.p: Posts for each platform, images, videos, games and code, made on this machine with ELI beside you on the project. Specialist models load only for the job that needs them; one main model stays loaded.
Every output's models and licences are recorded, and what a model makes is marked as AI-generated in the file.
